messages.subject: predicted values
parts:
Hi all:
I am trying to reproduce the graphic created by 'forecast' with
ggplot2

library(forecast)
weightData <- data.frame(weight = c(2.1,2.4,2.8,3.6,4.1,5.2,6.3),week
= 1:7)
weight <- as.numeric(weightData$weight)
predicted <- forecast(weight,h=3,level=95) # see the predicted
values by forecast
predicted
myplot <- forecast(weight,h=3,level=95)
plot(myplot)

# with ggplot
ggpred <- ggplot(data=weightData,aes(weightData$week,weight)) +
geom_line()
ggpred
newdata <- data.frame(week=1:10)
predWT <- predict(lm(weight~week,data=weightData),newdata)
predWT
qplot(predWT$week,predWT$weight,predWT)
I would like to add the predWT to the ggpred graphic but I can't
extract the Point Forecast column from forecast
Thanks

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: predicted values
parts:
Inspecting the output of str(predicted), I came up with this:

forecast <- with(predicted, data.frame(
weight = as.numeric(mean),
upper = as.numeric(upper),
lower = as.numeric(lower),
week = length(x) + seq_along(mean)
))

ggplot(weightData, aes(week, weight)) +
geom_line() +
geom_smooth(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), data = forecast,
stat = "identity")

# Or maybe

weightData$upper <- weightData$weight
weightData$lower <- weightData$weight

both <- rbind(weightData, forecast)

ggplot(both, aes(week, weight)) +
geom_smooth(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), stat = "identity",
colour = "black", fill = "yellow")


Hadley
